from hep_lfx import HepComponent, component, payload
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data
class HepSummary(HepComponent):
 display_name='汇总全面巡检结果'
 inputs=[DataInput(name='check_routine', display_name='check_routine', required=True),DataInput(name='check_vulnerabilities', display_name='check_vulnerabilities', required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name="result",display_name="结果",method="build")]
 async def build(self)->Data:
  return Data(data=await component("summary",{"routine":payload(self.check_routine),"vulnerabilities":payload(self.check_vulnerabilities)},self._id))
